A FEW LOOSE THREADS

Good questions.

Here’s how the pieces fit.

What exactly is Stitchr?+

Stitchr is a no-code product concept for connecting existing services into one business app. The vision combines a customer-facing experience, coordinated workflows, and a dashboard tailored to your business.

How is this different from connecting two tools?+

A connection moves information between tools. Stitchr’s goal is to bring those connections into a complete experience: a usable app for customers, rules for your workflows, and a shared view for your team.

Do I need to know how to code?+

The intended experience starts with your business needs and visual workflows. You choose the tools and define what should happen. Developers can extend the idea with APIs and custom logic where a business needs more control.

Does Stitchr replace my existing tools?+

The idea is to connect the tools you use. Services such as Stripe and Supabase would continue to handle their own functions and accounts, while Stitchr brings the experience together.

Can I connect my tools and publish an app today?+

This is an interactive product preview. The dashboard uses sample data, and live connections, account creation, and app publishing are not enabled. The examples illustrate the intended product experience, rather than confirmed integrations.

What will it cost?+

Stitchr pricing hasn’t been announced. Any future plan should clearly separate the cost of Stitchr from charges for the third-party tools connected to it.

EVERY GREAT APP STARTS WITH A THREAD.

You’ve got the tools.
Let’s make them work together.

A clearer way to build. A simpler way to run your business.
